note: Set A is better. Both sets correctly extract the explicit text values (damping ratio, gains at 0°) but struggle with graph readings at unspecified angles (23°, 25°). Set B contains a clear directional misread for Proportional Gain at 25° (0.005 s, which is higher than the 20° value despite the decreasing trend), whereas Set A's value (0.004 s) is at least consistent with the 20° value. Set B also includes exact duplicate claims (e.g., Proportional Gain 0.020 s at 0° appears twice) and quotes that imply specific numbers (e.g., '0.002') exist in the text layer where only axis ticks (0.000, 0.005) are present.
remarks: Both sets over-extract precise values from the graph (Figure 7-4) at angles (23°, 25°) that lack gridlines or labels, leading to likely hallucinations of precision. Set B's quote generation is particularly problematic, inserting numbers into quotes that are not in the OCR text layer.
